title: Signals: Continuous Diagnostics of AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.04507v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents can make incorrect decisions or waste resources even when their tools and infrastructure work normally. Their nondeterministic behavior makes these problems difficult to reproduce and diagnose. We developed Signals to identify such problems from agentic traces and suggest concrete remediations. We built the method around a taxonomy of 45 problem types across eight families, with definitions and evidence requirements for each type. The method distinguishes realized failures, risk exposures, and inefficiencies, groups related findings into engineering issues called Signals, and assesses their severity from the supporting evidence. Each Signal includes actions a developer can take and checks for evaluating the change. Further executions can add evidence to an existing Signal or reveal a new problem. translated_abstract: 即使在工具和基础设施正常工作的情况下，AI智能体也可能做出错误的决策或浪费资源。它们的不确定性行为使得这些问题难以复现和诊断。我们开发了Signals，用于从智能体执行轨迹中识别此类问题并提出具体的补救措施。我们围绕一个包含八个类别、45种问题类型的分类体系构建了该方法，并为每种类型提供了定义和证据要求。该方法区分已发生的故障、风险暴露和低效行为，将相关发现归类为称为Signals的工程问题，并根据支持证据评估其严重程度。每个Signal都包含开发人员可以采取的行动以及用于评估变更的检查项。进一步的执行可以为现有Signal添加证据，或揭示新的问题。我们在公开的智能体执行记录上对该方法进行了评估，在将Signals与参考问题匹配时达到了91.43%的F1分数。
tldr: 本文提出Signals系统，通过包含45种问题类型的分类体系对AI智能体执行轨迹进行持续诊断，将发现的问题归类为工程问题并评估严重程度和提供具体补救措施，在公开数据集上达到91.43%的F1分数。
en_tdlr: Signals is a continuous diagnostics system for AI agents that identifies realized failures, risk exposures, and inefficiencies from agent traces using a taxonomy of 45 problem types, groups findings into actionable engineering issues with remediation steps, and achieves 91.43% F1 when matching Signals to reference issues.
